label: Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph (Gregorian Missal)

chants.vernacular_text: God is in his holy dwelling place; the God who causes us to dwell together, one at heart, in his house; he himself will give power and strength to his people. ℣. Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered; and let those who hate him flee before his face.
One thing have I asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord. ℣. To gaze in delight upon the Lord's beauty and to be sheltered in his holy temple.
Rejoice in the Lord, O you just. It is fitting that loyal hearts should praise him.
In you have I put my trust, O Lord; I said: "You are my God, my destiny is in your hands."
My son, why have you treated us so? Your father and I have been anxiously looking for you. How is it that you were seeking me? Did you not know that I must be about my Father's business?
Take the child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel; for those who sought the child's life are dead.
